disease_state.evidence: We developed a human cerebral organoid model derived from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) with targeted genome editing to abolish protein expression of the Contactin Associated Protein-like 2 (CNTNAP2) autism spectrum disorder (ASD) risk gene, mimicking loss-of-function mutations seen in patients.

sample_source.evidence: D30 organoids were transferred from culture plates, briefly washed in ice-cold DPBS (XXX), depleted from matrigel using the cell recovery solution (Corning Cat. No. 354253), supplemented with protease and phosphatase inhibitors, and subsequently lysed in a lysis buffer consisting of 4% SDS, 0.1M DTT, 0.1M Tris pH 7.4.
